_comment: The tile race roll-feedback seam. api-backend publishes one message per roll on the existing tile race command channel; discord-server renders it as a Components V2 card in the rolling team's own text channel and reports nothing back. Asserted by api-backend/app/tests/test_tilerace_roll_feed.py and discord-server/tests/test_tilerace_roll_contract.py.
_direction_comment: One way. Unlike setup/sync/teardown there is no result callback: the bot creates nothing, so api-backend has no ids to record. A team whose Discord is not provisioned has a null discord_text_channel_id and no message is published at all.

tile.title: Bandos armour
tile.description: Any two pieces from General Graardor.

notes: Trap: your next turn is skipped

_tile_comment: `tile` is null when the landed cell carries no tile - an empty cell, a pad, or a tile deleted from the repository since the board was built. The card then shows the roll and the notes alone.
_notes_comment: Landing side effects, already worded for the team: snakes/ladders movement, extra roll, skipped turn, reroll, and reaching the end pad. The bot prints them verbatim and never derives its own.
